title: SELECT BIBLIOGRAPHY OF WORKS ON MEDIEVAL RURAL SETTLEMENT 2015

Introduction.text: By ANDY FORD<sup>1</sup> This list includes books and articles on British and Irish settlement and landscape between the fifth and fifteenth centuries, published in 2015. It also includes publications on related topics. Please notify the Bibliographer of any omissions so that they can be included next year: andyford.marlow@btinternet.com.
